message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing).  

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French (including allied contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and later historical analyses; exact numbers vary slightly among sources. The high casualty toll contributed to the decisive defeat of Napoleon’s forces and marked the end of his reign.
